newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol to invest 12 bln pta in LPG storage.
newsitem.headline: Repsol to invest 12 bln pta in LPG storage.

text.p: Spanish energy group Repsol said on Friday it would invest some 12 billion pesetas to build an underground storage unit for liquid butane and propane near the southern city of Cartagena.
The storage unit has capacity for 120,000 cubic metres of butane and 80,000 cubic metres of propane and will be situated between the refinery and the logistics unit.
This will mean that the Cartagena port in the region of Murcia will be the entry point for around 800,000 tonnes of product per year, more than half of Spain's total imports, Repsol said.
